en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Nasr, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup>

having said regarding the divorced woman: ‘When the proof is established for her that he has divorced her since such and such (a day), so her waiting period had passed, so she is irrevocably divorced’.
en.sarwar: 6. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu Nasr who has narrated the following: “Abu al-Hassan al-Rida’, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
If proof is established that she was divorced on such and such date which proves the expiration of her ‘Iddah (waiting period) she becomes a stranger for him.’”
